mapper.select: SELECT id FROM fishhub_note.t_note WHERE id > #{lastId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_note_count (note_id, like_total, collect_total, comment_total) VALUES
(#{item.noteId}, #{item.likeTotal}, #{item.collectTotal}, #{item.commentTotal})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_total = VALUES(like_total), collect_total = VALUES(collect_total), comment_total = VALUES(comment_total)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM fishhub_user.t_user WHERE id > #{lastId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_user_count (user_id, fans_total, following_total, note_total, like_total, collect_total) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.fansTotal}, #{item.followingTotal}, #{item.noteTotal}, #{item.likeTotal}, #{item.collectTotal})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fans_total = VALUES(fans_total), following_total = VALUES(following_total), note_total = VALUES(note_total), like_total = VALUES(like_total), collect_total = VALUES(collect_total)
